reports.title: Disclaimer regarding forward-looking statements in the quarterly report

lines: The IEA now forecasts global oil demand to fall by 2.7 mb/d in 2026 and recover by 2.0 mb/d in 2027, leaving consumption 0.6% below 2025 levels.
For 2027, the IEA expects global oil supply to rise by 6.6 mb/d, well ahead of demand, as OPEC+ production recovers and non-OPEC+ output keeps growing.
